sections.overview: Scyliorhinus canicula is a small benthic catshark of the northeastern Atlantic and Mediterranean.
sections.identification: It has numerous small dark spots; compared with the larger Nursehound, Scyliorhinus stellaris, its spots are smaller and more crowded.
sections.habitat: It lives mainly on sandy or gravelly seabeds, but also occurs over rocky or coralligenous bottoms.
sections.diet: It feeds on bottom-dwelling invertebrates and small fishes.
sections.reproduction: It is oviparous: females attach tough, tendril-bearing egg cases to underwater structures.
sections.ecology: Its egg case resembles that of Scyliorhinus stellaris, but is much smaller.
sections.conservation: The global IUCN assessment lists this species as Least Concern.
